title: Automated Mining of the ALMA Archive in the COSMOS Field (A<SUP>3</SUP>COSMOS). I. Robust ALMA Continuum Photometry Catalogs and Stellar Mass and Star Formation Properties for ∼700 Galaxies at z = 0.5-6

recipe.goal: Query archive, calibrate visibilities, and create continuum images
recipe.method: Query ALMA archive within 2 deg of COSMOS center, calibrate raw visibilities with scriptForPI.py, and image/clean all spectral windows into continuum maps using MFS (nterms=2) and Briggs weighting (robust=2), excluding beam < 0.1 arcsec.
key_parameters: search radius = 2 degrees, weighting = Briggs with robust=2 (or 0.5 for artifacts), MFS nterms=2, stopping criterion S/N = 4, 5 pixels per beam, PBA >= 0.2, beam >= 0.1 arcsec

recipe.goal: Blind source extraction on PBA-uncorrected continuum images
recipe.method: Identify emission islands and fit multiple 2D Gaussians on PBA-uncorrected images using PyBDSF, grouping Gaussians of the same island into one source.
assumptions: Constant noise across the PBA-uncorrected field of view; single PBA factor at source central position

recipe.goal: Compile prior source master catalog and perform prior source fitting
recipe.method: Cross-match 6 multi-wavelength COSMOS catalogs with 1 arcsec radius, correct mean astrometric offsets, pre-select candidates via aperture photometry (getpix), and iteratively fit point-source, circular Gaussian, and Sersic profiles using GALFIT.
key_parameters: master catalog matching radius = 1 arcsec; getpix apertures = 0.25'' to 2'' in 0.25'' steps; pre-selection S/N_total > 2 or S/N_peak > 3.6; position variation limit = 0.7 arcsec; size upper boundary = 3.0 arcsec

recipe.goal: Monte Carlo simulations for flux bias correction, error re-estimation, and completeness
recipe.method: Run FULL and PHYS Monte Carlo simulations by injecting Gaussian mock sources into PyBDSF residual images of 150+ representative pointings, recovering them with PyBDSF and GALFIT, and deriving 2D lookup corrections as functions of S/N_peak and Theta_beam.
key_parameters: 150+ representative images; 4225 realizations per image for FULL, 273 for PHYS; cross-match radius = 1.5 arcsec for PyBDSF completeness
assumptions: Gaussian source morphology with axis ratio 0.2 to 1.0; PHYS simulation assumes 2SFM, Davidzon et al. (2017) SMF, Sargent et al. (2014) MS, van der Wel et al. (2014) and Fujimoto et al. (2017) sizes

recipe.goal: Catalog merging and machine-learning counterpart association
recipe.method: Select blind detections with S/N_peak > 5.40 and prior detections with S/N_peak > 4.35, cross-match within 1.0 arcsec, and classify counterpart reliability using a Gaussian Process classifier trained on visual inspection and multi-wavelength cutout parameters.
key_parameters: S/N_peak > 5.40 (blind), S/N_peak > 4.35 (prior); cross-match radius = 1.0 arcsec; training/validation split = 60%/40%; features = Sep., S/N_ALMA, S/N_Ref., S./Ref., Ext., crowdedness, clean

recipe.goal: Predict and subtract strong (sub-)mm emission line contamination
recipe.method: Predict CO, [C I], [C II], and [N II] line luminosities from empirical line-L_IR relations using source redshift and SFR, check whether lines fall into the ALMA spectral windows, and subtract predicted line flux contribution from continuum.
key_parameters: lines predicted: CO (2 <= J_upper <= 10), [C I] (370, 609 um), [N II] (122, 205 um), [C II] (158 um)
assumptions: Empirical line-L_IR correlations from De Looze et al. (2011), Zhao et al. (2013, 2016), Sargent et al. (2014), Liu et al. (2015), Valentino et al. (2018)

recipe.goal: Multi-wavelength SED fitting to derive stellar masses, IR luminosities, and SFRs
recipe.method: Fit UV-to-mm/radio SEDs with MAGPHYS at fixed prior redshifts (iterating over inconsistent prior-z values and with/without 24 um data) and with MAGPHYS+photo-z to obtain uncertainties, flagging >5 sigma ALMA SED-excess outliers.
key_parameters: inconsistent prior-z threshold Delta z > 0.15 * (1+z); SED-excess outlier threshold S_OBS / S_SED > 1.77 (5 sigma); photo-z range z = 0 to 8
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM cosmology (H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_M = 0.3, Omega_0 = 0.7), Chabrier (2003) IMF, energy balance between UV/optical dust attenuation and IR/mm dust emission, Kennicutt (1998) SFR_IR calibration

score_reason: All raw ALMA data, calibrated continuum FITS images, and final photometry/property catalogs are publicly archived at IRSA, and the imaging, source extraction, simulation, and SED fitting recipes are thoroughly documented; however, full end-to-end reproduction from scratch is hindered by reliance on two internal COSMOS catalogs (Salvato spec-z compilation and SPLASH supplementary catalog), unstated per-image manual flagging choices (<10% of maps), and unreleased pipeline wrapper scripts/lookup tables.
rediscovery_reason: Both the raw ALMA archival visibilities and the released continuum FITS images are public, the core software tools (CASA, PyBDSF, GALFIT, MAGPHYS) are standard and explicitly parameterized, and the catalog summary statistics and cross-method comparisons provide clear quantitative benchmarks.
